(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 103 Questi non ciberà terra né peltro, 104 ma sapïenza, amore e virtute, 105 e sua nazion sarà tra feltro e feltro. Reference Translation (provided): He shall not feed on land or goods, but wisdom and love and valor, and his birthplace shall be between Feltro and Feltro.

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST**
- **Line 103** *Questi non ciberà terra né peltro* → **Locked Meaning**: There exists an individual (the referent of *Questi*) such that **¬[ciberà(he, terra) ∨ ciberà(he, peltro)]**. In plain‑English: *He will not feed on land nor on goods.*
- **Line 104** *ma sapïenza, amore e virtute* → **Locked Meaning**: The same individual possesses the three qualities **sapïenza**, **amore**, and **virtute**: **has(he, sapïenza) ∧ has(he, amore) ∧ has(he, virtute)**. In plain‑English: *but wisdom, love and valor.*
- **Line 105** *e sua nazion sarà tra feltro e feltro* → **Locked Meaning**: The nation/birthplace belonging to the individual will be located **between** the two places named *Feltro*: **location(nazion(he), between(feltro₁, feltro₂))**. In plain‑English: *and his birthplace shall be between Feltro and Feltro.*
